executive_digest: M&A & PORTFOLIO EXIT — MARVELL ($115B LUMENTUM DEAL): Marvell (MRVL) agreed to acquire Lumentum (LITE) in a $115B all-stock deal (Nov 3, 2026); both stocks plunged (~$91B combined value wiped out) on massive dilution and downgrades (BofA to Neutral PT $225, TD Cowen PT cut 50%). Karan SOLD 100% of MRVL ($33,029.23 in Fidelity Margin ...2854, realizing +$12,111.23 gain and reducing margin debit from -$52,523.98 to -$19,494.75). LITE is disqualified as a standalone buy; Coherent (COHR) is now our sole #1 independent InP laser & OCS champion.

EARNINGS BLOWOUT & $20B LTA — COHERENT (COHR): Reported Q1 FY2027 revenue of $2.37B (+56% YoY), adj EPS of $2.09 (beat by $0.07), signed a $20B PhotonLink hyperscaler Long-Term Agreement (LTA), and guided FY27 revenue growth >60% ($3B+ quarter by Q4 FY27, $4B quarter in FY28).

SEMIANALYSIS RESEARCH HIGHLIGHTS: (1) SpaceX/xAI building 13GW AI cloud in 18 months (+50GW global DC capacity in 2027, moving shortage back to chips/CoWoS/HBM); (2) GDPx benchmark shows best frontier AI agent scores just 12% on real-world work (0% in finance/legal), proving 100x+ test-time compute scaling wall ahead; (3) Bipartisan Texas ERCOT permit risk validates divesting CIFR; (4) ASML developing its own Hybrid Bonding tool (bullish for owned ASML, key watch on BESIY).

SCALE-UP & WFE EARNINGS BEATS: Astera Labs (ALAB) Q3 revenue jumped +154% YoY to $584.9M (Q4 guide $730M-$750M, Scorpio >$1B run-rate); Credo (CRDO) won OCP approval for 2 optical telemetry standards; KLA (+29% YoY rev, $4.7B Q2 guide), ASM International (€1.16B record Q3 rev on N2 GAA ALD), and Advantest (record HBM4 tester outlook) all beat.

material_events.headline: Marvell Agrees to Acquire Lumentum in Historic $115B All-Stock Deal; Both Stocks Plunge (~$91B Value Wiped Out)
material_events.summary: Marvell (MRVL) announced a $115B all-stock acquisition of Lumentum (LITE) to combine optical DSPs with InP lasers. Wall Street slashed ratings (BofA downgraded MRVL to Neutral PT $225 from $400; TD Cowen cut PT in half) citing equity dilution, while LITE plunged >17% as shareholders convert into diluted MRVL stock and optical OEMs (Ciena, Cisco) evaluate independent laser supply.
material_events.portfolio_action: Supply-chain read-across: Lumentum ceases to be a standalone optical pure-play once merged into Marvell, leaving Coherent (COHR) as the largest independent US vertically integrated 6-inch InP laser and Optical Circuit Switch (OCS) supplier.

material_events.headline: Coherent (COHR) Reports Record $2.37B Q1 FY27 Revenue (+56% YoY), $2.09 EPS Beat & Signs $20B PhotonLink Hyperscaler LTA
material_events.source: Coherent Corp. Q1 FY2027 Form 10-Q & Press Release
material_events.summary: Coherent posted Q1 FY2027 revenue of $2.37B (+50-56% YoY) and adjusted EPS of $2.09 (beating consensus by $0.07), signed a $20B PhotonLink Long-Term Agreement (LTA) with a tier-1 hyperscaler, and raised FY27 revenue growth guidance above 60% (projecting $3.0B+ quarter by Q4 FY27 and $4.0B quarter in FY28).
material_events.portfolio_action: Supply-chain read-across: Confirms multi-year hyperscaler demand for 6-inch InP CW/EML lasers, 800G/1.6T optical transceivers, and Optical Circuit Switches (OCS), with positive upstream read-across to InP substrates (AXTI) and MOCVD reactors (AIIXY).

material_events.headline: SemiAnalysis: (1) SpaceX 13GW AI Cloud in 18 Months, (2) GDPx Benchmark Shows Best AI Agent at 12%, (3) Texas Datacenter Permit Risk & ASML Hybrid Bonding Tool
material_events.source: SemiAnalysis (Dylan Patel / Maya Barkin / Max Kan)
material_events.summary: Latest SemiAnalysis research highlights: (1) SpaceX/xAI building 13GW of AI compute in 18 months (+50GW global DC buildout in 2027, moving the shortage back to chips); (2) GDPx real-world benchmark where top frontier AI scores just 12% (0% in finance/legal), proving massive test-time compute scaling ahead; (3) Bipartisan 2028 Texas datacenter permit freeze risk; and (4) Patent/roadmap evidence that ASML is building its own Hybrid Bonding tool.
material_events.portfolio_action: Supply-chain read-across: Reinforces wafer fab equipment and packaging demand (ASML, TSM, DSCSY, LSRCY, ASMIY, ONTO, ATEYY), highlights ERCOT regulatory risk for debt-funded Texas data-center builds (CIFR), and introduces long-term competitive watch on BESIY from ASML.

material_events.headline: Astera Labs (ALAB) Q3 Revenue Jumps 154% YoY to Record $584.9M; Guides Q4 to $730M-$750M as Scorpio X-Series Passes $1B Annualized
material_events.summary: Astera Labs doubled Q3 revenue to $584.9M (+154% YoY) and guided Q4 to $730M-$750M as Scorpio X-Series smart fabric switches surpassed $1B annualized run-rate and Aries 7 debuted. Meanwhile, Credo (CRDO) secured OCP approval for two optical telemetry standards and expanded its Oracle AI interconnect deployment.
material_events.portfolio_action: Supply-chain read-across: Confirms accelerating rack-level scale-up connectivity demand across Active Electrical Cables (CRDO), PCIe/UALink fabric switches (ALAB), and precision silicon MEMS reference clocks (SITM).

material_events.headline: KLA (Rev +29% YoY, $4.7B Q2 Guide), ASM International (€1.16B Record Q3 Rev on 2nm GAA ALD) & Advantest (Record HBM4/SoC Test Outlook) Beat Estimates
material_events.source: KLA / ASM International / Advantest Earnings Filings
material_events.summary: Leading WFE suppliers reported Q3 beats: KLA (KLAC) grew revenue +29% YoY with $936M in quarterly buybacks and guided Q2 to $4.7B +/- $200M; ASM International (ASMIY) hit record €1.16B Q3 revenue on N2 2nm Gate-All-Around ALD orders; and Advantest (ATEYY) raised full-year AI SoC & HBM4 tester guidance.
material_events.portfolio_action: Supply-chain read-across: Confirms N2 2nm GAA Atomic Layer Deposition (ASMIY, KKSIY), process control metrology (KLAC), and HBM4 burn-in test (ATEYY) capital intensity expansion.

analyst_notes.author: Apex Compute Investment Committee
analyst_notes.thesis_note: EXECUTED PORTFOLIO ACTION: Sold 100% of MRVL (212.393 sh, $33,029.23 in Fidelity Margin ...2854, realizing +$12,111.23 ST gain and reducing margin debit from -$52,523.98 to -$19,494.75). Disqualify LITE as a standalone Buy due to MRVL stock merger conversion, and concentrate optical laser/OCS exposure in owned Coherent (COHR, $21,107 in Roth_Fidelity ...5830).

analyst_notes.author: Apex Compute Investment Committee
analyst_notes.thesis_note: SMALL/MID-CAP (<= $25B) INFLECTION HUNT: Added 11 sourced US-tradable bottleneck candidates across 48V vertical power (VICR), batch GAA/NAND ALD (KKSIY), diamond dicing consumables (ASAAF), ABF substrates (IBIDF — requires Google compliance pre-clearance), Silicon Photonics foundry (TSEM), InP wafer substrates (AXTI — capped <=2.5% on China MOFCOM export-permit risk), optical test (SLOIF), InP MOCVD reactors (AIIXY), 1.6T optical assembly (FN), fluxless TCB bonders (ASMVY), and HBM4 MEMS probe cards (MJPNF).

analyst_notes.author: Apex Compute Investment Committee
analyst_notes.thesis_note: MEMORY CYCLE-PEAK GUARDRAIL: While Micron (MU, 80.7% GM) and SK Hynix (SKHY, 62.0% GM) have 2026-2027 HBM3E/HBM4 capacity sold out under LTAs, DRAM contract price growth is decelerating (+80% Q2 -> +40% Q3 -> +20% Q4 2026). Avoid commodity DRAM peak-P/B traps (Nanya 2408.TW, Winbond 2344.TW) and tilt incremental HBM4 upside toward <= $25B consumable & bonding specialists (FORM, MJPNF, ASMVY, DSCSY, ONTO).

analyst_notes.author: Apex Compute Investment Committee
analyst_notes.thesis_note: DIVEST & UPGRADE ROTATION: Exit legacy high-PEG industrial robotics (FANUY 2.60x PEG, YASKY 2.13x PEG), debt-funded Texas data-center builder (CIFR), and #2 EDA peer (CDNS 2.48x PEG) to eliminate the remaining -$19,494.75 Fidelity margin debit and concentrate Roth capital in #1 bottlenecks.

specialist_research_feed.portfolio_action: 100x TEST-TIME COMPUTE SCALING WALL: SemiAnalysis's GDPx benchmark shows top frontier models score just 12% on real-world enterprise tasks—proving multi-year demand for N2 GAA wafers (TSM, ASML, ASMIY), 16-Hi HBM4 (DSCSY, ONTO, MU, FORM), and low-latency interconnects (CRDO, COHR, AVGO).

specialist_research_feed.title: The Datacenter Backlash Goes Bipartisan: Next Week's Midterms and the 2028 Buildout
specialist_research_feed.summary: 2027 is largely locked in, but 2028 faces a prolonged Texas ERCOT permit freeze risk as both parties run on tighter grid interconnection rules.
specialist_research_feed.portfolio_action: VALIDATES CIFR DIVESTMENT ($15.8k in Schwab Roth): SemiAnalysis & Bernstein highlight Texas ERCOT permit and grid politics risk for Texas data-center builds (CIFR is contracted but debt-funded). Retain CORZ ($20.3k) & NBIS ($21.6k) and rotate CIFR into equipment monopolies VRT & MU.

specialist_research_feed.title: ASML Is Building a Hybrid Bonding Tool!
specialist_research_feed.summary: Patent filings, supply-chain reports, and ASML's own roadmap reveal ASML is developing a next-generation Hybrid Bonding tool to compete in 3D wafer/die bonding.
specialist_research_feed.portfolio_action: BULLISH FOR OWNED ASML ($21.4k) / COMPETITIVE WATCH ON BESIY: SemiAnalysis reports ASML is developing its own hybrid bonding tool via patent filings & roadmap—reinforcing our owned ASML lithography monopoly while requiring close monitoring of BESI's (BESIY) long-term >75% Cu-Cu hybrid bonding share.
